svg.title: PI Lab uppercase Pi icon
svg.desc: The Avenir Next Medium uppercase Pi, converted to a path and centered in black on a white macOS-style rounded tile with transparent outer corners.
svg.metadata: Source glyph: Avenir Next Medium face index 5 from /System/Library/Fonts/Avenir Next.ttc. Original 533×708-unit outline scaled to geometric bounds 436.638×580 at x=293.681, y=222 and centered on the 1024×1024 canvas. The path is outlined, so rendering this asset does not require the source font. See ICON-PROVENANCE.md for the reproducible extraction record.
